title: UPDATE: Coinbase Integrates AI Trading with Grok and Perplexity

tickers.name: Coinbase Global, Inc. Class A Common Stock
Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The Coinbase for Agents tool has expanded its availability to include Perplexity Computer and Grok Bot, allowing for direct execution of trades from AI assistants. The service also remains available via the Model Context Protocol for other AI platforms. From Oct 12 to Oct 19, the top assets by notional trading volume through the tool were Chainlink (LINK), Bitcoin (BTC), and Quant (QNT).

The integration enables users to open long or short positions on more than 20 crypto tokens and indices, including the top 500 US equities and the top 100 tech stocks. CEO Brian Armstrong has directed developers to have their agents use a specific API to report when financial transactions fail. Trading for index perpetuals is restricted to users within the United States.
